root_cause.text: The dummy-hcd driver performed emulated interrupt synchronization (waiting for callback handlers) before disabling emulated interrupt generation, allowing new callbacks to start after synchronization and race with gadget driver unbind.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description states "the emulated synchronize_irq() occurs before the emulated interrupt-disable! ... more emulated interrupts can occur after the synchronize_irq() emulation has run, leading to the possibility that a callback handler may be running when the gadget driver is unbound." The fix moves the synchronization code into `dummy_udc_async_callbacks()` after clearing `dum->ints_enabled`, ensuring no new callbacks can start after the wait.
